description: This file defines the HyperlinkRenderer class, responsible for rendering Hyperlink objects to Rich Text Format (RTF) within the MigraDoc document processing library. It includes methods for rendering hyperlinks with various types and styles, integrating font rendering and handling external links.

classes.name: HyperlinkRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that translates Hyperlink objects into RTF markup, handling different hyperlink types, associated styles, and font rendering.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the rendering of a Hyperlink object to RTF, managing content start/end tags, hyperlink specifics, font styling, and nested elements.
